title: 36 Hours in Salzburg, Austria
abstract: Summer is when this compact Austrian city of medieval alleys, majestic Alpine views and just 150,000 residents, bursts to life.

title: 36 Hours in Helsinki
abstract: Find the secret to happiness in Finland’s capital — perhaps while sweating in a wood-burning sauna or sipping cocktails on a schooner.

title: 36 Hours in Provincetown, Mass.
abstract: P-town offers overlapping identities: one of America’s oldest art colonies, nature preserve, thriving L.G.B.T.Q. resort and historic Portuguese fishing village.

title: 36 Hours in Denver
abstract: Explore city trails, see a concert under the stars or admire the snow-capped Front Range from a rooftop bar in Colorado’s capital.

title: 36 Hours in Seattle
abstract: Beyond the museum-studded central districts, three colorful neighborhoods encapsulate the Emerald City’s natural beauty, history and vibrant culture.
